newsList.title: Further Accuracy Update and Addition of New Categories!
newsList.body:
Hello karters, Pika here.

First of all I have reworded some of the Rules: some of them had typos and some of them were not clear enough, so I simply updated them for more clarity.
Along with that, I have also made a thread where you can find out the sources of each player without a Speedrun.com

game.name: Mario Kart DS Category Extensions
game.rules:
The Full Game Leaderboards generally include Real Time with loads speedruns (RTA) and In-Game Time runs outside of Time Trials (IGT).

All the Level Leaderboards runs are done in Time Trials with the usage of In-Game Time (IGT).

categories.name: No-MT
categories.rules:
Play the track in Time Trials without releasing any boost from a Mini-Turbo.

Video or Picture proof is required.

Notes: you can start a Best Lap run in lap 2, as long as you do not charge a Mini-Turbo before the lap 2 starts.
You can also end a run with a Mini-Turbo in a charged state as long as it is unleashed after the end of the run.

categories.name: No-R
categories.rules:
Play the track in Time Trials without pressing the R button.

Video or Picture proof is required.

Notes: you can start a Best Lap run in lap 2, as long as you do not use the R button before the lap 2 starts.

categories.name: No A
categories.rules:
Play the track in Time Trials without pressing the A button.

Video or Picture proof is required.

Notes: you can start a Best Lap run in lap 2, as long as you do not use the A button before the lap 2 starts.
If you have a record set using this strategy, you can still submit it in the "Prohibited Starts" category.

categories.name: Crash%
categories.rules:
Select Luigi's Mansion in Time Trials and crash the game as fast as possible using the staircase at the entrance of the mansion.

In-Game Time (IGT) is used for time calculation: your score will be the one displayed on screen when the console crashes.

Video or Picture proof is required.

categories.name: All Trees
categories.rules:
Hit all 139 trees in the game that the player can hit during normal gameplay. This consists of the following courses and trees:
* Cheep Cheep Beach - 16
* Luigi's Mansion - 37
* Desert Hills - 9
* Delfino Square - 11
* DK Pass - 16
* Peach Gardens - 10
* GBA Peach Circuit - 17
* GBA Luigi Circuit - 22
* Palm Shore (Battle Course) - 1

Timing is Real Time with loads (RTA) and starts upon selecting the first track and ends on the frame the final tree is hit.

Video proof is highly encouraged.

categories.name: Castle%
categories.rules:
Select Mario Circuit in Time Trials and get on the balcony of the castle as fast as possible.

In-Game Time (IGT) is used for calculation: your score will be the one displayed on screen when the kart is not visible on the grass anymore. THE TIMER MUST BE VISIBLE ON SCREEN IN YOUR PROOF. OTHERWISE WE DO NOT KNOW WHAT YOUR TIME IS!

If you are taking a screenshot, try to press START and pause in the exact moment your kart is not visible anymore.

Video or Picture proof is required.

categories.name: Balloon Battle%
categories.rules:
Select Balloon Battle mode and defeat all the CPUs.

The settings should be:
- CPU Kart: Any (but Easy is best for speedruns)
- Rules: Free
- Team: Off

Video or Picture proof is required. Video of the full run is heavily suggested if possible. Also please try to avoid uploading proof in the form of a youtube short as it doesn't properly embed and makes proof checking far more difficult. Thanks!

Achieve the maximum completion of the game by all metrics.
This includes:

- Winning and achieving 3 stars on all Grand Prix in 50cc, 100cc, 150cc and Mirror 150cc
- Completing all missions (including Level 7) with 3 stars
- Beating all staff ghost times in Time Trials

Timing starts when selecting the first objective (whether that is a Grand Prix, Time Trial or Mission) and ends upon finishing the last objective.

We recommend starting with a Grand Prix and finishing with a Time Trial so there is no ambiguity.

**Revised timing and breaks rules:**
Because of the hand-shredding nature of this run, the runner is allowed to take two breaks during the run where the timer can be paused and the runner may rest, eat or just not use their hands for a bit. These breaks may not exceed a combined 4 hours in length.

Additionally, a third extra break, not exceeding ~5 minutes may be taken for any random life event that happens to occur during this run. You shouldn't be penalized for having stuff happen while you're playing, especially since this run has zero down time. The exact amount of time isn't specified but use your best judgement and try to return to the run as soon as possible.

While your timer is paused, you may not make any inputs in game whatsoever. If an input is made that does something within the game your timer will be considered un-paused and the run resumed.

Picture proof of the Grand Prix, Time Trials records and Mission Mode tables is required.
Video proof is strongly suggested.

categories.name: Missions Bosses
categories.rules:
Beat the bosses of Mission Mode.
Only the bosses of the Boss Missions are included.

Timing is Real Time with loads (RTA) and starts upon selecting the first mission and ends at the completion of the last mission.

Video proof is highly encouraged.

categories.name: 32 Tracks 100cc
categories.rules:
This run can be done in Grand Prix mode or in VS mode, though latter is recommended.

Real Time with loads (RTA) is used.

In Grand Prix mode, timer starts upon pressing "OK" when selecting Mushroom Cup in 100cc and ends at the finish line in GCN Yoshi Circuit.

In VS mode, settings should be:
- Class: 100cc
- CPU: Any
- Course: In Order
- Team: Off.
Timer starts upon pressing "OK" when selecting Figure-8 Circuit (or confirming the settings) and ends at the GCN Yoshi Circuit finish line.

Picture proof is required and has to include your points and the one of the CPU.
Video proof would be preferred.

categories.name: 32 Tracks 50cc
categories.rules:
This run can be done in Grand Prix mode or in VS mode, though latter is recommended.

Real Time with loads (RTA) is used.

In Grand Prix mode, timer starts upon pressing "OK" when selecting Mushroom Cup in 50cc and ends at the finish line in GCN Yoshi Circuit.

In VS mode, settings should be:
- Class: 50cc
- CPU: Any
- Course: In Order
- Team: Off.
Timer starts upon pressing "OK" when selecting Figure-8 Circuit (or confirming the settings) and ends at the GCN Yoshi Circuit finish line.

Picture proof is required and has to include your points and the one of the CPU.
Video proof would be preferred.

categories.name: No-Dpad / No-Cpad
categories.rules:
Play the track without pressing any directional button (UP, DOWN, RIGHT or LEFT in the Dpad or Cpad).

Some tracks are impossible to complete. If a track has no record, it means it is impossible to complete.

We also would like to note that softlocks can happen in some tracks.

Video or Picture proof is required.

Notes: you can start a Best Lap run in lap 2, as long as you do not use the D-Pad to setup a better angle for your kart.
If you have a record set using this strategy, you can still submit it in the "Prohibited Starts" category.

categories.name: Alternative Routes
categories.rules:
Play the track, but use a specific slower alternative route.
Some tracks do not have any alternative path and some tracks may have many alternative paths, so remember to submit to the chart of the right alternative path (check the variables).
The description of a specific route can be found in the rules of said route.

Video or Picture proof is required.

categories.name: Slow%
categories.rules:
Just like a standard 32 track run except your objective is the opposite! Get the highest time possible by any means necessary. (No delaying on results screens, you must try to get through those quickly)

Starting rules must be 150cc, CPU Difficulty Any, Races In Order, Races 32 and Teams Off. The time starts upon hitting ok to enter Figure 8 Circuit and ends upon crossing the finish line on Yoshi Circuit.

values.name: Nintendo DS
values.rules:
These runs have to be done in the stage Nintendo DS.

In Game Time (IGT) is used for calculation: your time will be the one displayed on screen in the moment you hit the final CPU. If you are taking a screenshot, while you are playing, remember to press START to pause in the exact moment you hit the CPU. Make sure that the CPU is visibly killed.

In Game Time (IGT) is used for calculation: your time will be the one displayed on screen in the moment you hit the final CPU. If you are taking a screenshot, while you are playing, remember to press START to pause in the exact moment you hit the CPU. Make sure that the CPU is visibly killed.

values.name: All Stages
values.rules:
Win a Balloon Battle mode match in all the 6 stages in order, starting with Nintendo DS and ending with Pipe Plaza.

The settings should also include:
- Course: In order

Timer is Real Time with loads (RTA) and starts upon selecting Nintendo DS and ends after killing the last CPU on Pipe Plaza.

values.name: All Bosses
values.rules: Beat all the Boss Missions in Mission Mode, from Level 1 to Level 7.

values.name: Boss 1 to 6
values.rules: Beat the always visible Boss Missions in Mission Mode, from Level 1 to Level 6.

values.name: No Spinning Bridge
values.rules: You must not touch the spinning bridge, but complete your run by jumping directly into the underneath garden.

values.name: Spinning Platform Left Exit
values.rules: You must not use the right exit out of the spinning platform, but left one.

values.name: Longest Route
values.rules: You must not touch the spinning bridge, but complete your run by jumping directly into the underneath garden and you must not use the right exit out of the spinning platform, but left one.

values.name: Full Course
values.rules: Full 3 or 5 laps run.

values.name: Best Lap
values.rules:
1 lap or Best Lap run.

Note: most of the times, starting a Best Lap run on the 2nd Lap is faster. However, if you decide to do that, please remember that...
- For No-MT runs, no Mini-Turbo can be charged in Lap 1. However, a run can still be valid if a Mini-Turbo is charged in the final turn of Lap 2 and unleashed on Lap 3.
- For No-R runs, the R button cannot be used during Lap 1.
- For No-Dpad / No-Cpad runs, no directional input is allowed during Lap 1.

values.name: Wooden Bridges Only
values.rules: You must not go through or over any of the waterfalls, but over the wider wooden route.

values.name: Vanilla Route
values.rules: No off-road or gap shortcut can be taken, except for the wooden ramp in the mid-section of the track.

values.name: No Corner Cuts
values.rules:
You must not take any cut. This includes the 2 Non-PRB-allowed Corner Cuts, the 2 PRB Glitch-SCs and the former Rail Glitch-SC.

To avoid inaccuracies as these forbidden shortcuts aren't used by most people...
- for 3lap, only times faster than 2:00:000 can be submitted.
- for Flap, only times faster than 0:40:000 can be submitted.

values.name: Glitch-SC
values.rules: The Glitch-SC must be used. Only Best Lap is possible.

values.name: Prohibited Starts (Best Lap)
values.rules: This category is made for runs which use a Mini-Turbo or an A-button press to start a Best Lap run done in lap 2+.

values.name: Prohibited Starts (Best Lap)
values.rules: This category is made for runs which use a specific angle set up with the usage of the Dpad / Cpad to start a Best Lap run done in lap 2+.
